name: Adaptive Thresholding for Rapid Transfer Function Switching
definition: A density encoding scheme that allows rapid switching between predefined transfer functions by storing two-bit codes per cell, indicating which density interval the cell's highest corner voxel belongs to.
summary: Adaptive Thresholding for Rapid Transfer Function Switching is a classification optimization that enables instant switching between predefined transfer functions by pre-computing two-bit codes per voxel cell to skip transparent regions without re-evaluation.
